reason: Wrong vertical: Coinflow (coinflow.cash) is a Chicago-based web3/stablecoin payment service provider (~25-48 employees, $25M Series A led by Pantera/CMT Digital/Coinbase Ventures, Oct 2025) that merely counts gaming platforms among its merchant customers - it is not a PC/console game studio entering full production, so there is no publisher milestone, build/release pipeline, or Tech Director being pulled off the game, and none of the live postings (Security Engineer, Applied AI Lead, ML Lead, Forward Deployed Engineer, Senior Merchant Underwriter, BD Manager, SDR) redescribe the technical-operations gap Ben Cole fixes - the Security Engineer role is a fintech SecOps/PCI build, not an unowned studio ops layer.
